intro.text: A servant at Mercystar's palace in T'Telir.

items.text: Rariv is in a hallway with three other servants when Vasher breaks in, binds Taff with an Awakened rope and throws his sheathed sword at them. Lolan picks it up, while Rariv and another servant run for help. Rariv gives Lightsong his version of events when the god looks into the incident.
